narrative: 把摄影机直接固定在车身上。产品展示、追逐戏中的强调节点、以汽车为主角的场景：镜头紧贴着这一具车身，镜头上沾点灰尘也无妨。
从另一辆车上拍摄、却始终看不到这辆车车身的跟拍镜头，不算车载机位。绑身机位在车内；车载机位在金属车身上。
how: 用吸盘、吸盘臂架，或刚性护笼固定在引擎盖、车门、保险杠或轮拱上。广角。
画面中要出现部分车身，车轮或沥青路面在画面中流动。提示词：Car-grip mount on [Subject]'s vehicle, hood or door as the rig, chrome and asphalt in one plane.
when: 当汽车本身是主角，或追逐戏需要一个车身固定机位的节拍时使用。不要用它拍车内对话。
vs: 绑身机位（Buckle Up）指的是车内座舱；锁定跟踪（Locked-On）是“镜头粘附在主体上”这一更宽泛的概念。
低角度（Low Angle）是一种可以在街道上静止拍摄的机位高度；而车载机位之所以低，是因为保险杠本身就低，道路之所以在滑动，是因为车在移动。
examples_film: 《浪人》（Ronin）和《极盗车神》（Baby Driver）使用引擎盖和车门机位，让金属车身始终留在近景，而道路在其后流动。语法：车身与沥青路面在一个刚性画面组合中并存。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是从另一辆车上拍摄的跟拍镜头，画面中却没有任何车身。破绽在于：一个干净利落的四分之三侧面（Three-Quarter Angle）车身镜头，摄影机像是悬浮在空中。
解决办法：把摄影机固定在这辆车上，让金属车身留在近景，任由道路在背后滑动。

faq.q: 电影中的车载机位（Car Grip）是什么？
faq.a: 车载机位是固定在车身上的摄影机。引擎盖、车门或保险杠留在近景中，道路则在下方滑动而过。

faq.q: 车载机位（Car Grip）与绑身机位（Buckle Up）的区别
faq.a: 绑身机位在车内，与人待在一起；车载机位在车外的金属车身上，镀铬部件与沥青路面共处一个画面。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用车载机位？
faq.a: 当汽车本身是主体，或追逐戏需要一个车身固定机位的节拍时使用。不要用它拍车内对话。

faq.q: 如何为 AI 图像或视频撰写车载机位的提示词？
faq.a: 描述固定在引擎盖或车门上的机位，画面中要有车身。示例：Car-grip mount on [Subject]'s vehicle, hood or door as the rig, chrome and asphalt in one plane.

narrative: Bolt the camera to the machine. Product, chase punctuation, a car as the hero: we are glued to this one body, dirt on the lens allowed.
A tracking shot from another car that never sees this car's body is not grip. Buckle-up is inside; grip is the metal.
how: Suction, hostess, or a rigid cage on hood, door, bumper, or wheel arch. Wide.
Part of the body in frame, wheels or asphalt traveling. Prompt: Car-grip mount on [Subject]'s vehicle, hood or door as the rig, chrome and asphalt in one plane.
when: Use it when the machine is the hero or when a chase needs a body-mounted beat. Do not use it for a cabin talk.
vs: Buckle Up is the cabin. Locked-On is the general glued-to-subject idea.
Low Angle is a height that can be static on the street; grip is low because the bumper is low, and the road is sliding because the car is moving.
examples_film: Ronin and Baby Driver use hood and door mounts so metal stays in the near plane while the road travels. Grammar: bodywork plus asphalt in one rigid pair.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a tracking shot from another vehicle with no bodywork in frame. The tell: a clean three-quarter of a car, camera floating.
The fix: bolt to this car, keep metal in the near plane, let the road slide.

faq.q: What is Car Grip in film?
faq.a: Car grip is a camera bolted to the vehicle's bodywork. Hood, door, or bumper stays in the near plane while the road slides underneath.
Buckle up is inside the cabin with the people. Car grip is outside on the metal, chrome and asphalt in one plane.

faq.q: When should I use Car Grip?
faq.a: Use it when the machine is the subject or a chase needs a body-mounted beat. Do not use it for a cabin dialogue.

faq.q: How do I prompt Car Grip for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write a mount on hood or door with bodywork in frame. Example: Car-grip mount on [Subject]'s vehicle, hood or door as the rig, chrome and asphalt in one plane.
